concerns: price_below all major moving averages (EMA 9/21/20/50, SMA 21/50/200)
technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic reversal signals present, but price remains below all key moving averages with negative momentum confirmation and weak trend structure—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (40/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (3+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (244.6) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 70 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with supertrend bullish signal and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment present reversal setup potential near support at 34.73.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative MACD histogram, zero volume confirmation (OBV false), weak trend structure (ADX false), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and no fundamental/smart money support—macro environment severely unfavorable.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with supertrend bullish and EMA 50/200 alignment present technical reversal setup; price at support (34.73) offers defined risk entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (244.6), and zero volume/momentum confirmation expose this trade to macro-driven capitulation; earnings in 70 days add event risk with no fundamental support.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see reversal setup; fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly oppose due to macro headwinds and lack of smart money conviction.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 12 positions open in Energy sector; adding EQT increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without offsetting conviction.
